indexes.//: The chaser finds the businesses that turned reminders on with a collection-group query. Collection-group queries are not served by the automatic single-field indexes, so without this the scheduled pass fails outright.
Prior attempts for one debtor, oldest first: an equality on one field ordered by another needs a composite index, and this is what the escalation counts.
The webhook finds the invoice a payment belongs to by the account it landed in, and falls back to the reference typed into the narration. Both are collection-group lookups.
The narration fallback, matched on the invoice id.
